context_requirements: Active sterol-depletion response (SREBP-2 pathway) in the cell line
Dependence on de novo cholesterol synthesis or high LDL receptor responsiveness
Proliferating cells for the late G1 arrest phenotype
falsifiers: No induction of HMGCR, HMGCS1, FDFT1, SQLE, LDLR or INSIG1 at 6 h or 24 h in any line
No G1 arrest or proliferation-down signature at 24 h
Strong and specific up-regulation of interferon or unfolded protein response genes instead of sterol genes

evidence.supports: OSC inhibitor U18666A sequesters cholesterol and transcriptionally up-regulates LDL receptor in human HepG2 hepatocytes
OSC inhibitor RO 48-8071 inhibits pancreatic cancer cell viability and induces G1 cell cycle arrest
Mevalonate pathway products are required for cell cycle progression, linking sterol synthesis inhibition to G1/S arrest

changes: Removed ACAT2 from proximal_up and late_up: ACAT2 is not a canonical SREBP-2 sterol-depletion target and its direction is not justified by the cited OSC-inhibitor evidence.
Removed ACAT2 from the up lists because it is a cholesterol-esterifying enzyme whose transcriptional response to OSC inhibition is not supported by the retrieved abstracts.
